ns2:section.sectionText: Non-Advertising majors who have been accepted into the PR Certificate program should visit https://illinois.edu/fb/sec/4727686 to indicate their interest in this and other required PR Cert. courses. Seats are limited and are available on a first come, first served basis. Please note: If available, seats will open to College of Media Soph., Juniors and Seniors on November 17 at 11:00 a.m. and to Campus Soph., Juniors and Seniors on Nov. 19 at 11:00 a.m.
